# sendio_api_keys (Data Source)

Lists the team's active API keys. Tokens are never returned, only their prefixes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sendio_api_keys" "all" {}

output "api_key_names" {
  value = data.sendio_api_keys.all.api_keys[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `api_keys` (Attributes List) The API keys. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--api_keys))

<a id="nestedatt--api_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `api_keys`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the key was created.
- `domain_id` (String) Domain a sending key is limited to.
- `id` (String) API key id.
- `last_used_at` (String) When the key was last used.
- `name` (String) Key name.
- `permission` (String) `full_access` or `sending_access`.
- `token_prefix` (String) First characters of the token.
